scope: Existing Unravel backend audit and leakage-safe improvement

findings.finding: Previous Isolation Forest was fit and scored on the same fault run.
Previous threshold was the 95th percentile of the evaluated fault-run scores.
Previous implementation did not use the 170 normal-operation recordings for training.
Previous report only tested overlap with a broad cause window; it did not report onset delay.
Previous ranking considered all observed variables, allowing downstream alarms and process counters to outrank causal inputs.
Documented manipulated variables and cause timestamps are now used only for held-out evaluation, never fitting or inference.

improvements: Binseg and PELT onset delay evaluation
limitations: The fault-window labels measure the documented manipulation interval, not necessarily the first observable symptom.
The authentic normal-operation data contain multiple operating regimes; a single global normal model therefore remains conservative.
Ranking is graph-constrained and parameter-free but is still observational evidence ranking, not causal identification.
